name: cc-looker
description: Incrementally search your local Claude Code sessions, grouped by project, and jump straight into one.

commands.title: CC Looker: Open Claude Code Project

ccLooker.claudeProjectsPath.description: Override the path to Claude Code's projects directory. Leave empty to use $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/projects or ~/.claude/projects.

ccLooker.openInNewWindow.description: Open the selected project in a new VS Code window instead of replacing the current one.
